# Compliance and Ethics

This part asks what an analyst owes to the participants whose
records make a pharmaceutical or clinical study possible, before
the industry chapters that follow assume it is already settled.

- @sec-deident sets out the HIPAA de-identification pathways, what
  each costs the analysis, and the obligations that survive
  de-identification.
- @sec-deident-practice applies those rules to a release, with
  assertions that fail if an identifier survives.
- @sec-ethics argues that the apparatus of this book does not, by
  itself, keep an analysis from misleading, and names what does.

If the quiz at the start of a chapter is easy, skip to the next.
